primary_sources.exact_import: Finite-base-change semistable reduction for smooth projective generic curves,and a proper regular nodal model after resolving total-space nodal singularities. The original volume pullback,Hartogs extension,logarithmic period bound and Cauchy-chain trace are written internally,not quoted as a Stacks theorem.

new_written_arguments: In complex dimension2,semistable curve reduction replaces arbitrary finite critical fibres by reduced nodes afterfinitebasechange. Properness gives the original volume as a regular2-form on the chosen smooth model by codimension-one extension and Hartogs. Node periods areO(log);undoing s=t^e gives exponent-1+1/e>-1. Finite compact-chain trace extends the previous Cauchy-period exclusion without assuming isolated critical points.

For a degreeD affine-quadric phase,finite boundary valuations satisfyvH>=D vu and volume orderA(E)-1-N vu. Local lct(H)>N/D kills EVERY finite boundary volume pole,including vertical exceptional divisors. The multiplicity estimateD>Nm is a sufficient exact certificate.

On the sphere null conic,the leading divisor has degree2D. Every octahedral orbit has>=6 points,every icosahedral orbit>=12;thus leading multiplicitym obeysD>=3m orD>=6m. The dimension2 certificate is automatic in EVERY degree and for every complex invariant phase/lower coefficient choice.

Both complete original A_Gamma^T algebras consequently have eventual pure radical0,not just a minimal seed class or thin phases. All maximal tori and all algebraic automorphic images are covered by intrinsic Haar transport. Full exceptional MZ is not reduced to them.

Over any commutativeC-algebra,eventual T-invariant pure radical equals nilpotents. Use a Qbar form and finitely generated residue coefficient fields,not a false embedding of arbitraryC-extensions intoC fixingC. Fixed-degree ordinary pure ideals have radical equal to the coefficient maximal ideal;finite-power inclusion gives a universal nilpotence/all-marker cutoff and a terminating theoretical prefix certificate algorithm,no values computed.

A pure phase with a nonzero infinitesimal left stabilizer is torus-fixed and impossible if the Lie element is semisimple,or unipotent-fixed and one-sided-weight safe if it is nilpotent. Every possible full failure has finite stabilizer for the left action and every automorphism-conjugated one. Finite stabilizer is not a purity or failure certificate.
essential_boundaries: Semistable and lct inputs are classical;their analytic/topological combination and all MZ applications are INTERNAL WRITTEN. Selected exact controls do not independently verify semistable trace,Hartogs,all valuations or universal nilpotence.
The nonisolated-period extension is asserted only for complex surfaces. In higher dimensions the volume certificate alone is geometric;the earlier isolated-critical-point period hypothesis remains.

Strict multiplicity inequality is sufficient,not necessary;failure of this certificate does not imply a phase is pure or bad. Tetrahedral minimum orbit4 only gives equality and is not settled by this argument.
OriginalT-invariant closure includes complex/image-interior phases but does not reduce any full non-T-invariant phase to this subalgebra. Full thin and image-interior marked problems remain.

Over nonreduced rings only the eventual radical is nilpotents. Not all nilpotents are pure from first power,and ordinary pure ideals are not replaced by their radicals. Fixed-degree uniform prefix/nilpotence existence is not a computed numeric cutoff or an implemented campaign.
The matrix weight cutoff applies after linear left conjugation;arbitrary nonlinear automorphisms transport safety without an unchanged original-degree bound.
